review_method: Each full-resolution generation was inspected when created, then all nine accepted scenes were reviewed together in chronological order on automation/production-work/basil-beaver-leaky-river-workshop-01/asset-contact-sheet.png.

accepted_assets.review: One readable leak, stopped blue wheel, stable cast and open stream with two fish.
Exactly one leaf, three stones, five sticks and one clay bowl are separated and readable.
The same single leaf visibly floats toward Pippa's catch basket; wheel stays stopped.
Exactly three planted stones remain stable while visible water threads the gaps.
Corrected frame has exactly three vertical plus two horizontal sticks; water remains visible through openings.
Over-under reed weave is visible inside the same five-stick frame and flow is reduced to droplets.
Clay seals only constructed-panel edges while Moss and two fish preserve the open-stream safety message.
First wheel-motion payoff follows the lifted mill gate; repaired panel is intact and fish passage stays open.
Final-only log notes, reed shaker and gourd drum create one restrained musical climax beside the working wheel.

rejected_generations.reason: The first stick-frame generation contained more than five sticks and contradicted the count lyric; it was rejected and not copied into production assets.
